At base this case fails on a different path from the one the request describes. data[0] is None, so the `isinstance(data[0], np.ndarray)` branch is skipped and pd.util.hash_array raises TypeError ('unhashable type: numpy.ndarray'), not the ValueError from the uniform-array conversion.
